title: 2026 Friendsgiving Challenge: More than $236,000 raised for Central Texas Food Bank
summary: The Central Texas Food Bank and KXAN need your help to make sure some of our neighbors don't go hungry this holiday season. The 2026 Friendsgiving Challenge is back for another year!
